sources.content:
KARTHIK NAIR
Compiler Engineer · Bengaluru, India
karthik.nair.compilers@example.com · +91 90000 01234 · github.com/karthiknair

SUMMARY
Compiler engineer with 6.5 years of experience in optimisation passes, type checking and language tooling. I work
close to the metal and I am happy to stay there.

EXPERIENCE

Lattice Compilers — Compiler Engineer                                             Bengaluru · Apr 2022 – Present
Compiler toolchains for embedded DSPs.
- Wrote 14 LLVM optimisation passes for an embedded DSP target; median kernel speed-up of 1.9x across 62 benchmarks.
- Cut compile time for the largest build from 9 minutes to 3 minutes by caching analysis results across passes.
- Designed the type checker, including generics, for the company's kernel language.

Orbit Toolchains — Software Engineer                                             Bengaluru · Apr 2020 – Mar 2022
- Built the parser and error recovery for a configuration language used by 120 internal tools.
- Wrote a fuzzer that found 37 parser crashes before release.

PROJECTS
- tinyssa — A small SSA-based optimiser in Rust with constant folding and dead-code elimination.
  github.com/karthiknair/tinyssa
- mlir-toy-dialects — Teaching dialects and lowering passes for MLIR. C++. github.com/karthiknair/mlir-toy-dialects
- parser-recovery — Error-recovering parser combinators in OCaml. github.com/karthiknair/parser-recovery

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Computer Science — Bharathi Institute of Technology, Chennai                                 2016 – 2020

SKILLS
Languages: Rust, C++, OCaml, Python (basic)
Compilers: LLVM, MLIR, parsing, type systems, dataflow analysis, fuzzing
Basics: SQL, HTML and CSS, JavaScript, Docker
